next_steps.action: Disconnect adapter and battery. Wait 30 s. Measure resistance from rail to ground.

measure.where: ALW rail test points (typically near the standby controller)
measure.instrument: DMM resistance mode (200 ohm range first)
measure.expected: +3VALW typically >50 ohm; +5VALW typically >30 ohm. Values <10 ohm indicate a hard short on the rail or on a downstream rail powered through a diode-OR.
measure.safety: Discharge all caps before measuring. ALW rails have many ceramic caps that hold charge briefly.

interpretations.then: Hard short. Do NOT re-apply power. A shorted downstream rail (e.g. a 3.3V peripheral) can pull +3VALW down through a load switch. Hunt the short before continuing.
No short. Proceed to check standby controller VIN.
